title: Daily Workout · November 13
note: Friday · approximately 55 minutes: six established opening stretches (6 min), calorie-focused incline treadmill walking (35 min), supported upper-body strength (9 min), and introductory posture practice (5 min). Inclines remain: fixed 3% steady, alternating 2%/4% every 3 minutes; walking only, up to 4.2 mph, no jogging. Use HOKA Clifton 9 Wide (2E) as a comfortable short-term comparison; the 850+ mile pair is due for replacement. Avoid only New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v15 due to tingling, not the whole brand. Stop for tingling, numbness, painful heel strikes, or sharp lumbar pain. Do not force lumbar extension in posture work. Preserve all six opening stretches and original timers; plow pose with feet suspended remains listed as preference but skip unless medically cleared due to neck/spine loading. Its existing floor-contact photograph is reference-only, not an exact depiction. No actual exercise performance or dumbbell loads assumed.

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.detail: 1 min · gently alternate sides within the minute
items.instructions: Seated on floor, one leg straight, other foot beside buttock; lean back with arm support only if comfortable. Skip if it provokes lumbar or knee pain. Use existing StretchCoach image registry entry.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Soles together, sit upright, do not force knees down. One 60-second hold, not separate left/right holds.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Use comfortable, controlled motion. Do not force rotation or continue if it provokes sharp back pain.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.detail: 1 min timer · only if specifically cleared
items.instructions: Straight legs with feet suspended, not touching floor. Advanced neck/spine-loading inversion; do not perform without clearance for current lumbar symptoms. Existing photograph showing floor contact is reference-only.

items.name: Arm circles
items.instructions: Gentle circles, comfortable range; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Overhead triceps stretch
items.instructions: Gentle overhead stretch without forcing the shoulder or arching the back; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Warm-up walk
items.instructions: Use HOKA Clifton 9 Wide (2E), not the New Balance 1080 v15. Begin comfortably and stop if symptoms recur.

items.name: Steady brisk walk
items.instructions: Maintain a constant 3% incline for this entire steady segment; walk with a natural stride and reduce speed if needed.

items.name: Incline walking intervals
items.detail: 15 min · 3.6–4.2 mph · alternate 2% and 4% incline every 3 min
items.instructions: Three-minute blocks at 2%, 4%, 2%, 4%, 2%. Brisk walking only, not jogging. Stop if tingling or back pain returns.

items.name: Cool-down walk
items.instructions: Gradually ease down to a comfortable pace.

items.name: Dumbbell bench press
items.instructions: Flat bench, feet supported on floor. Light manageable weight; avoid arching back or breath-holding. Skip if painful.

items.name: Supported dumbbell rows
items.instructions: Keep chest supported and lumbar spine neutral; avoid trunk rotation. Skip if painful.

items.name: Dumbbell biceps curls
items.instructions: Light-to-moderate weight; stand or sit supported, no swinging or back extension.

items.name: Band pull-aparts
items.instructions: Use a light band at chest height, elbows soft, shoulder blades move gently together. Keep ribs stacked over pelvis; no backward lean.

items.name: Chin tucks
items.instructions: Eyes level, draw chin straight back gently without tipping head up or down; relax between repetitions.

items.name: Wall-anchored band chest stretch
items.detail: 60 sec · 30 sec each side · light tension
items.instructions: With a securely mounted resistance band anchor near shoulder height, stand facing away and hold the band in one hand at shoulder level. Gently step forward until you feel a mild chest stretch. Keep ribs stacked over pelvis, shoulder relaxed, and lower back neutral; do not force the arm behind you. Switch sides after 30 seconds. Stop if painful.

items.name: Wall angels
items.instructions: Stand with your back, shoulders, head, and buttocks at the wall, feet 6–8 in (15–20 cm) forward. Gently draw your ribs down and tuck your chin; keep a neutral spine without forcing your lower back flat. Start with arms in a V and hands on the wall. Slowly bend your elbows and slide your hands down to a W just above shoulder height. Pause for a count of 5, then return to the V. Use only a comfortable, pain-free range and stop if you cannot maintain alignment.
